    62	## Strict is the new cool
    63	
    64	Strict linting offers the following benefits to developers and companies:
    65	1. Ensures consistency - no matter who works on it, the end product will always be the same dependable code

    67	3. Efficient code reviews - each piece of code has a similar familiar style and syntax. If it passes all the checks, there's little left to review!

    69	5. Reduce code redundancy - Sometimes we write complex code as we are thinking in a certain way about a problem. The linter offers suggestions that can help simplify the code and eliminate redundant statements
